note: written once, on the first build. Every later build reads this file instead of re-stamping the rules, so a registration time cannot drift forward to stay ahead of a bet. Changing a rule's signal, thresholds, universe or settlement rule changes its hash and will not verify.

registrations.name: Fade the big home favourite

universe.games: every regular-season game in the official log with a final score, in date order, from 2026-10-20
universe.excluded: no game is excluded; the backtest uses all 183 finals captured
universe.live_window: the same rule is applied to the 22 upcoming games on 2026-11-15..2026-11-17 to produce projections

registrations.settlement: the named side covers the number originated by this project, measured against the official final margin. A push is not a win and not a loss; pushes are excluded from the hit rate and counted separately.
registrations.rule_text: When estimator A's margin puts the home side at 7 points or more, take the AWAY side against our own line.
registrations.hash_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) with body = the nine fields listed in hashed_fields
registrations.provenance_note: Backtested against the project's own originated line, settled from the official final. No market price is involved, so the number measures whether our own line is biased in a way the rule can exploit -- not whether a bookmaker would have paid.

registrations.name: NULL CONTROL: a coin flip

universe.games: every regular-season game in the official log with a final score, in date order, from 2026-10-20

registrations.settlement: the control fires on a fixed coin flip independent of any team, pitched at the same assumed price. It MUST show no edge; if it shows one the measurement, not the market, is broken.
registrations.rule_text: A fixed-seed coin flip decides the side. It has no signal by construction. If it shows an edge, the measurement is broken, not the market.
